detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: Autocatalytic reaction networks sustain memory through algebraic conditions on their stoichiometric matrices, which define subgraphs capable of irreducible bistable states. These states permit history-dependent behavior distinct from simple hysteresis, as global network functionality emerges from the aggregation of local stoichiometric bounds.
